name: Honeypots: Detrimental Fakes (d8)
description: Knowledge (engineering) result of 60 or lower with a natural 11–20. The character believes it until the consequences arrive.

results.description: A “safe” route through the next scene leads straight into a Mood Gas vent (DC 22, no warning).

results.description: The character “disables” a defence and actually arms it: the next encounter gains a Stagehand Drone with a full force field.

results.description: The interface plugs into the character's mind: Celmak gets a free Muse scan on them, with a −4 penalty on the save.
